en: Vintage multi-view postcard showing three black‑and‑white scenes of a rural inn and its surroundings. The upper left image depicts an outdoor garden restaurant with many tables and chairs under trees, filled with guests and children. The upper right image shows the facade of a country guesthouse with a sign on the building and numerous people in traditional clothing seated and standing in front. The bottom image is a wide landscape view of a valley with fields, scattered houses, and wooded hills. Printed German text below the images identifies the guesthouse and its location near Graz.
